title: Design an observable heuristic-imitation architecture proxy
doing: Propose a fixed seed-disjoint state bank and supervised entity-only/CNN/grid-token comparison with at least two fit seeds, common warm start, observable-expert labels, held-out loss and survival/noise follow-up. Freeze counts/budgets and gates; no data collection, label generation, fitting or evaluation.
expected: Explicit spatial bias may improve observable-expert imitation or sample efficiency, but extra capacity, lost geometry in rasterization, a weak expert or distribution shift can erase gains. Proxy loss is not evidence of better PPO training or a teacher suitable for promotion.
actual: Prepared E/C/P observable-expert supervised proxy: two fit seeds per architecture, seed-grouped384/64/64 pool split,1024 dataset games and up to32768 states; held-out imitation metrics plus K1/K4 survival and P6 robustness follow-up. Core ceiling7h44m,11h56m with standing noise; no new cohort. No labels, fits, model loads or evaluations occurred; all efficacy remains unobserved.
next_step: Obtain source-only implementation approval first, then independent observability/initial-parity/resource review and separate bounded dataset/fit/evaluation approvals. No original FullState/oracle labels, implicit B5 approval, held-lease disposition or checkpoint promotion.

evidence.label: Observable expert, same-input state bank and bounded architecture proxy; no execution
Analytical architecture cost and raster input-parity scope; no model built
